key_impacts: Accident led to a long-term decommissioning programme; a Mid-and-Long-Term Roadmap for Units 1–4 was adopted in December 2011.
Large volumes of contaminated water have been generated; about 1,100,000 m3 of treated water were stored on-site as of October 2018, with production reduced but ongoing.
Fuel debris remains in Units 1–3, requiring investigation, sampling, and development of retrieval methods.
Removal of spent fuel from pools is necessary; preparations for Unit 3 are well advanced and for Units 1 and 2 are progressing.
Disposition of ALPS-treated water remains undecided; tank capacity (~1.37M m3) is expected to be reached in three to four years, prompting urgent decisions.
